description: Synthetic Markdown regression fixture, written to pin specific adapter and gate behaviour. Labels are the expected tool behaviour, not human-reviewed editorial judgements, and results do not estimate production accuracy.
preset_toml:
version=1
name='fixture'
[[gates]]
id='g'
kind='sentence_length'
max_words=6
delimiters='.!?。！？'

examples.text:
- one two three four
- five six seven eight
- nine ten eleven twelve
examples.why: Each list item ends a sentence.

examples.text:
| one two three four | five six seven eight |
| --- | --- |
| nine ten eleven twelve | one two three four |
examples.why: Each table cell ends a sentence.

examples.text:
# one two three four

five six seven eight
examples.why: A heading is not joined to the next paragraph.

examples.text:
one two three four
five six seven eight
examples.why: A soft wrap does not end a sentence.

examples.text:
1. one two three four
2. five six seven eight
examples.why: Each ordered item ends a sentence.

examples.text:
- one two three four five six seven
- short
examples.why: One bullet alone exceeds the limit.

examples.text: 短い文です。次の文です。
examples.why: CJK delimiters split, and each sentence has one whitespace-separated word.

examples.text: 一 二 三 四 五 六 七 八。
examples.why: Word counting remains whitespace-based for CJK text.
